title: The Age of Innocence
author: Edith Wharton
summary: In 1870s New York high society, Newland Archer is engaged to the conventional May Welland but falls for her unconventional cousin, Countess Olenska. Wharton portrays a world ruled by social expectation.
readIf: you like restrained, elegant novels about manners and unspoken longing.
skipIf: you want fast plotting or a satisfying, romantic ending.
